job: Start at the front of the docs: search, three ways in, every endpoint, the SDKs and the guides people read most.
purpose: A docs landing page: a hero with a search that opens the palette, three Start here cards, the endpoint cards, SDKs with copy buttons and a list of popular guides. It is static and has no states of its own: a failed load is the docs shell's, and the search palette has its own no-results.
useWhen: Readers arrive at the docs and need to find their way in.
The docs have several sections and tools.

avoidWhen.when: The page explains one thing in depth.
The page is about one endpoint.

states.name: default
states.how: none beyond the default: the page is static; search, via the palette, has its own empty result
